bpm.name: BPM
bpm.description: Enter the song's BPM to make gameplay sync.

use-player-clicks.name: Use player clicks
use-player-clicks.description: If enabled, the gameplay will form around your clicks. If not, clicks will be inserted at random.

frame-perfect.name: Frame perfect clicks
frame-perfect.description: Aligns spike corridors and obstacles with 1-frame precision so that every jump/click requires exact frame-perfect timing.

live-builder-mode.name: Live Route Builder
live-builder-mode.description: Automatically generates obstacles, floors, platforms, and corridors around player hitboxes while playing in editor playtest.

live-build-click-only.name: Build Only When Clicking (Только при зажатии)
live-build-click-only.description: Places obstacles and corridor blocks ONLY while holding the button. When released, blocks stop spawning.

timing-window-frames.name: Click Timing Window (Frames)
timing-window-frames.description: Exact number of frames of tolerance for jumps and corridors. 1 = Frame Perfect, 2-3 = Demon, 4-6 = Hard/Normal, 8-12 = Easy. Places obstacles so jumping/clicking is strictly mandatory with no second paths.

obstacle-distance.name: Obstacle Clearance Distance
obstacle-distance.description: Distance in pixels between player hitboxes and generated obstacles. Lower values make gameplay tighter and harder, higher values make it wider and more forgiving.

live-ground-platforms.name: Live Ground Platforms
live-ground-platforms.description: Automatically places solid ground blocks beneath the player's feet when running and landing.

live-jump-obstacles.name: Live Jump Obstacles
live-jump-obstacles.description: Places hazard spikes along the ground under jump arcs between takeoff and landing.

wave-slopes.name: Wave slopes
wave-slopes.description: Uses 45-degree slopes instead of vertical spikes for Wave boundary.

layout-pattern-mode.name: Layout Pattern Mode
layout-pattern-mode.description: Select obstacle generation style: 'Turn Pillars' spawns pillars at clicks and releases (like screenshots 2 and 3). 'Full Corridor' spawns a continuous tunnel.

corridor-fill.name: Corridor Blocks (Квадраты)
corridor-fill.description: Spawn backing square blocks behind corridor slopes. Toggle off for slopes only without square blocks.

corridor-fill-depth.name: Block Fill Depth (Слои квадратов)
corridor-fill-depth.description: Number of square block layers behind slopes (1 = neat thin cap like screenshot, 2 = 2 rows).

wave-spikes.name: Spikes on wave slopes
wave-spikes.description: Places additional hazard spikes along the wave corridor.

spike-margin.name: Spike margin
spike-margin.description: Controls how close the spikes are to the player. Lower values make the gameplay less forgiving.

camera-free-mode.name: Free camera
camera-free-mode.description: Enables free mode for gamemode portals.

experimental-gameplay.name: Experimental gameplay
experimental-gameplay.description: Adds experimental variations to existing gameplay elements, such as late ring timings and jump pads while flying.

debug-trail.name: Debug trail
debug-trail.description: Leaves an object trail behind the player while generating. An X indicates the jump button is pressed.

ai-min-hold.name: Min Click Duration (Frames)
ai-min-hold.description: Minimum frames between inputs at 240 FPS (higher = easier/longer)

ai-max-hold.name: Max Click Duration (Frames)
ai-max-hold.description: Maximum frames between inputs (higher = wider/longer slopes)

ai-api-key.name: AI API Key
ai-api-key.description: API Key for AI layout generation (Shugg.ru)

ai-model.name: AI Model
ai-model.description: Model ID to use (for Shugg use 'shugg')

ai-prompt.name: AI Prompt
ai-prompt.description: Custom prompt describing gameplay rhythm and difficulty (e.g. 'fun readable wave section with smooth slopes')
ai-prompt.default: fun and readable rhythmic wave layout with smooth slopes and good music sync
